title: Correction: Hackdex AI disclosure requirements
message:
Hi,

We need to correct two details in our previous email about the updated Hackdex Terms of Service.

AI use in coding must also be disclosed. Our earlier email said general programming was exempt. That exemption has been removed. Disclosure covers AI-generated or AI-modified content and code included in your hack or its Hackdex page, including work you edited afterward or received from contributors.

Disclosures will use a dedicated AI disclosure form instead of a section in your hack's description. The form will let you declare the extent of AI use and will be available by October 3, 2026. Every creator will need to complete it, even if no AI was used. If you already added a disclosure to your description, please complete the form once it is available.

AI use remains allowed with disclosure so players can make an informed choice. Credits still belong in a Credits section of your hack's description or on a publicly accessible credits page linked from that section.

The dates are unchanged. The updated Terms take effect on October 3, 2026. Hacks submitted before that date have until November 2, 2026 to meet the credits and AI disclosure requirements. New submissions must meet those requirements from October 3.

Sorry for the confusion caused by the earlier email. We've corrected the Terms and FAQ to reflect these requirements.

Terms: https://www.hackdex.app/terms
FAQ: https://www.hackdex.app/faq
Your hacks: https://www.hackdex.app/dashboard
